title: Step-by-step guide to painting your ceiling | Dulux
description:
Follow our step-by-step guide to painting your ceiling and learn how easy it is to refresh any room in your home with the right tools and paint. 
 
We begin with the items you’ll need for your project and show how to prepare the room and the ceiling surface for painting. Cleaning the ceiling is an essential part of the process, and we give you tips for the best way to do this.
 
Then, it’s time to get started on painting. For this project, we’re using Dulux Ceiling White, and the first step is cutting in. This is where you paint all those places a roller can’t reach. We explain the best cutting in techniques before showing you how to paint the main areas with a roller and then lay off the paint so there’s no streaking.

Featured products: 
Dulux Ceiling White: https://www.dulux.com.au/products/details/615d0115

Or visit our website https://www.dulux.com.au/how-to/preparation-and-painting-guides
